required.quote: Dentists shall complete forty (40) hours of continuing education with no more than twenty (20) hours to be completed online.

hours_per_period.quote: Dentists shall complete forty (40) hours of continuing education with no more than twenty (20) hours to be completed online.

requirements.value: Dentist must hold a general dentist license in good standing in another state, have practiced at least 500 hours within the previous 5 years, have passed a substantially equivalent regional examination, provide a letter of good standing from all states ever licensed in, and pass the Oklahoma jurisprudence examination.

credential_type.quote: No person shall practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting without first applying for and obtaining a license from the Board of Dentistry.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, except a licensed dentist, to practice or attempt to practice dentistry

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, except a licensed dentist, to hold oneself out to the public as a dentist or as a person who practices dentistry

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, except a licensed dentist, to practice or attempt to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pleading guilty/nolo contendere or being convicted of a felony, misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, sex offense, violent crime, Medicaid fraud, insurance fraud, identity theft, embezzlement, or controlled substance violation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pleading guilty or nolo contendere to, or being convicted of, a felony, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, any crime in which an individual would be required to be a registered sex offender under state law, any violent crime, Medicaid fraud, insurance fraud, identity theft, embezzlement or a violation of federal or state controlled dangerous substances laws;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting a false diploma, license, certificate, or other false information on an application or renewal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting to the Board a false diploma, license, or certificate, or one obtained by fraud or illegal means, or providing other false information on an application or renewal;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incompetent to practice due to persistent inebriety or drug addiction, or failing to report an impaired colleague within 72 hours.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being, by reason of persistent inebriety or addiction to drugs, incompetent to continue the practice of dentistry or failing to notify the Board of a licensee, permit holder, or other health professional that is practicing while impaired

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing a false, fraudulent, or misleading advertisement or statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing a false, fraudulent, or misleading advertisement or statement;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Authorizing or aiding an unlicensed person to practice dentistry or dental hygiene, or to perform a function requiring a Board permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Authorizing or aiding an unlicensed person to practice dentistry, to practice dental hygiene or to perform a function for which a permit from the Board is required;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Authorizing or aiding a dental hygienist to perform any procedure prohibited by the State Dental Act or Board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Authorizing or aiding a dental hygienist to perform any procedure prohibited by the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Authorizing or aiding a dental assistant to perform any procedure prohibited by the State Dental Act or Board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Authorizing or aiding a dental assistant to perform any procedure prohibited by the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay fees as required by the State Dental Act or Board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay fees as required by the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete continuing education requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete continuing education requirements;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as a specialist in a dental specialty without holding the required dental specialty license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing himself or herself to the public as a specialist in a dental specialty without holding a dental specialty license as listed in Section 328.22 of this title;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing below the basic standard of care, including failing to complete proper training for delegated procedures.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing below the basic standard of care of a patient which an ordinary prudent dentist with similar training and experience within the local area would have provided

disciplinary_grounds.description: Endangering patients by reason of a highly communicable disease without appropriate safeguards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Endangering the health of patients by reason of having a highly communicable disease and continuing to practice dentistry without taking appropriate safeguards;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry in an unsafe or unsanitary manner or place, including repeated failures to follow CDC or OSHA guidelines.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry in an unsafe or unsanitary manner or place including but not limited to repeated failures to follow Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) or Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) guidelines;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being shown to be mentally unsound.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being shown to be mentally unsound;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being shown to be grossly immoral and that such condition represents a threat to patient care or treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being shown to be grossly immoral and that such condition represents a threat to patient care or treatment;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incompetent to practice dentistry while delivering care to a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being incompetent to practice dentistry while delivering care to a patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence in the practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross negligence in the practice of dentistry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing repeated acts of negligence in the practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing repeated acts of negligence in the practice of dentistry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to or effecting a division of fees or agreeing to split a fee for dental services in exchange for patient referrals.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering to effect or effecting a division of fees, or agreeing to split or divide a fee for dental services with any person, in exchange for the person bringing or referring a patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being involuntarily committed to an institution for treatment for substance abuse, until recovery or remission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being involuntarily committed to an institution for treatment for substance abuse, until recovery or remission;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the services of a dental laboratory or technician without issuing a laboratory prescription, except as provided by statute.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or attempting to use the services of a dental laboratory or dental laboratory technician without issuing a laboratory prescription, except as provided in subsection C of Section 328.36 of this title;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding a dental hygienist to solicit patronage using oral prophylaxis lists from a prior dentist employer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, abetting, or encouraging a dental hygienist employed by the dentist to make use of an oral prophylaxis list, or the calling by telephone or by use of letters transmitted through the mail to solicit patronage from patients formerly served in the office of any dentist formerly employing such dental hygienist;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having more than the equivalent of three full-time dental hygienists for each dentist actively practicing in the same dental office.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having more than the equivalent of three full-time dental hygienists for each dentist actively practicing in the same dental office;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing a person not holding a Board-issued permit or license to assist in the treatment of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing a person not holding a permit or license issued by the Board to assist in the treatment of a patient without having a license or permit issued by the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly patronizing or using the services of a dental laboratory or technician who has not complied with the State Dental Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly patronizing or using the services of a dental laboratory or dental laboratory technician who has not complied with the provisions of the State Dental Act and the rules of the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Authorizing or aiding a dental hygienist, assistant, lab technician, or lab permit holder to violate the State Dental Act or Board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Authorizing or aiding a dental hygienist, dental assistant, dental laboratory technician, or holder of a permit to operate a dental laboratory to violate any provision of the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully disclosing information protected by HIPAA.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully disclosing information protected by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996, P.L. 104-191;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writing a false, unnecessary, or excessive prescription for a controlled dangerous substance, or prescribing opioids in excess of statutory maximum limits.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Writing a false, unnecessary, or excessive prescription for any drug or narcotic which is a controlled dangerous substance under either federal or state law, or prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or administering any drug or treatment without a valid dentist-patient relationship.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or administering any drug or treatment without having established a valid dentist-patient relationship;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or administering nitrous oxide gas in a dental office in an inappropriate or unauthorized manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or administering nitrous oxide gas in a dental office in an inappropriate or unauthorized manner;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in nonconsensual physical contact of a sexual nature with a patient, or verbal communication intended to be sexually demeaning to a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in nonconsensual physical contact with a patient which is sexual in nature, or engaging in a verbal communication which is intended to be sexually demeaning to a patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry without displaying the license and current renewal certificate at the primary place of practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry without displaying, at the dentist's primary place of practice, the license issued to the dentist by the Board to practice dentistry and the current renewal certificate;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being dishonest in a material way with a patient or during the practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being dishonest in a material way with a patient or during the practice of dentistry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to retain all patient records for at least seven years from the date of the last treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to retain all patient records for at least seven (7) years from the date of the last treatment as provided by Section 328.31b of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to retain the dentist's copy of any laboratory prescription for at least seven years.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to retain the dentist's copy of any laboratory prescription for at least seven (7) years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing a non-dentist corporation or entity to direct, control, or interfere with the dentist's clinical judgment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing any corporation, organization, group, person, or other legal entity, except another dentist or a professional entity that is in compliance with the registration requirements of subsection B of Section 328.31 of this title, to direct, control, or interfere with the dentist's clinical judgment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the dental act of another state resulting in a guilty plea, conviction, or suspension/revocation by another state board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the state dental act of another state resulting in a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, conviction or suspension or revocation or other sanction by another state board, of the license of the dentist under the laws of that state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate the State Dental Act, Board rules, or state/federal statutes relating to scheduled drugs, fraud, or violent crime.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate the provisions of the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board, a state or federal statute or rule relating to scheduled drugs, fraud, a violent crime

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the terms and conditions of an order imposing suspension or probation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the terms and conditions of an order imposing suspension of a license or placement on probation issued pursuant to Section 328.44a of this title;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate during an investigation or providing false information to the Board or its agents.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to cooperate during an investigation or providing false information, verbally or in writing, to the Board, the Board's investigator or an agent of the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having multiple administrative or civil actions reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having multiple administrative or civil actions reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete an approved two-hour course on opioid and scheduled drug prescribing within one year of obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete an approved two-hour course on opioid and scheduled drug prescribing within one (1) year of obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falling below the basic standard of care of a licensed dentist or other licensee pursuant to the State Dental Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falling below the basic standard of care of a licensed dentist or dentist practicing in his or her specialty, a dental hygienist, dental assistant, or other licensee or permit holder pursuant to the State Dental Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide patient records as required by state statute.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide patient records as provided by Sections 19 and 20 of Title 76 of the Oklahoma Statutes.

insurance_required.quote: All dentists in active practice licensed by the Board of Dentistry shall maintain a policy for professional malpractice liability insurance

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A mobile dental clinic providing dental treatment shall register with the Board of Dentistry

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the practice of dentistry in all of its branches
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the practice of dentistry in all of its branches;

value: Representing oneself to the public as being a dentist or as one authorized to practice dentistry
Diagnosing or examining clinical material
Treating diseases or disorders of the oral cavity, teeth, gums, maxillary bones, and associate structures
Removing human teeth
Repairing or filling cavities in human teeth
Correcting or attempting to correct malposed teeth
Administering anesthetics, general or local
Treating deformities of the jaws and adjacent structures
Using x-ray and interpreting dental x-ray film
Removing stains, discolorations, or concretions from the teeth
Operating or prescribing for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition connected with the human mouth
Taking impressions of the teeth and jaws
Furnishing, supplying, constructing, reproducing, or repairing prosthetic dentures, bridges, or other substitutes for natural teeth
Adjusting prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances, or other structures worn in the human mouth
Diagnosing, making, and adjusting appliances to artificial casts of malposed teeth
Writing a laboratory prescription to a dental laboratory
Owning, maintaining, or operating an office for the practice of dentistry
methods_authorized.quote: The following acts by any person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of the State Dental Act

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs including controlled dangerous substances, subject to statutory limits on opioid prescribing and requirements for valid dentist-patient relationship; must maintain a duty to guard against illegal diversion of controlled dangerous substances.
drug_authority.quote: Writing a false, unnecessary, or excessive prescription for any drug or narcotic which is a controlled dangerous substance under either federal or state law, or prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes;

value: Minimal sedation
Moderate sedation
Deep sedation
General anesthesia

Nitrous oxide (for dental hygienists as advanced procedure)
Mobile dental anesthesia provider
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: "Deep sedation" means a drug-induced depression of consciousness ... "General anesthesia" means a drug-induced loss of consciousness ... "Minimal sedation" means a minimally depressed level of consciousness ... "Moderate sedation" means a drug-induced depression of consciousness ... "Mobile dental anesthesia provider" means a licensed and anesthesia-permitted dentist, physician or Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: All licensees engaged in the practice of dentistry in this state shall notify the Board within twenty-four (24) hours of the discovery of a death of a patient, or an emergency hospital visit where the patient is admitted, pursuant to treatment in a dental office and potentially related to the practice of dentistry by the licensee.

specialist_license_available.quote: The Board of Dentistry may issue a dental specialty license authorizing a dentist to represent himself or herself to the public as a specialist, and to practice as a specialist, in a dental specialty.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Any person holding an Oklahoma specialty license that does not have an Oklahoma general dentistry license shall be limited to practicing that specialty for which they hold a license.

value: Direct supervision
Indirect supervision
General supervision
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Supervision" means direct supervision, direct visual supervision, indirect supervision or general supervision;

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: A dentist may authorize procedures to be performed by a dental hygienist, without complying with the provisions of paragraph 3 of subsection B of this section, if the dental hygienist has at least two (2) years' experience in the practice of dental hygiene, the authorization to perform the procedures is in writing and signed by the dentist

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist may employ not more than the equivalent of three full-time dental hygienists for each dentist actively practicing in the same dental office.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist with a minimum of two (2) years of licensed active hygiene practice may apply to the Board for an advanced procedure permit for elder care and public health.

value: Nursing facility, specialized facility, or nursing care component of a continuum of care facility
Assisted living center or continuum of care facility
Residential care home
Adult day care center or adult day care component of a continuum of care facility
Other healthcare facility or long-term care facility as specifically approved by the Board
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A licensed dentist may allow a dental hygienist with an elder care advanced procedure permit to treat patients under general supervision by utilizing teledentistry on a patient in: 1. A nursing facility, specialized facility, or nursing care component of a continuum of care facility ... 2. An assisted living center or continuum of care facility ... 3. A residential care home ... 4. An adult day care center ... 5. Another healthcare facility or long-term care facility as specifically approved by the Board of Dentistry.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: A mobile dental clinic providing dental treatment shall register with the Board of Dentistry

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: Volunteers shall use a form to be provided by the Board for any patient with clear instructions for any and all follow-up care.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: "Dental office" means an establishment owned and operated by a dentist for the practice of dentistry

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: a dentist who utilizes the services of a dental laboratory technician or dental laboratory shall furnish a laboratory prescription for each patient for whom a work product is prescribed.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: A dentist holding a valid dental license in Oklahoma may consult, diagnose and treat a patient of record via synchronous or asynchronous telecommunication between the patient and dentist.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: All patient records shall be maintained for seven (7) years from the date of treatment.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: a live, in-person cardiopulmonary resuscitation class approved by the Board

scope__sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: "Minimal sedation" means a minimally depressed level of consciousness, produced by a pharmacological method
"Moderate sedation" means a drug-induced depression of consciousness during which patients respond purposefully to verbal commands

dental assistant who has met the requirements as listed in Section 328.25 of this title and assists a dentist, pediatric dentist, or oral maxillofacial surgeon who holds a parenteral or general anesthesia permit
"Deep sedation" means a drug-induced depression of consciousness during which patients cannot be easily aroused but respond purposefully following repeated or painful stimulation.
"General anesthesia" means a drug-induced loss of consciousness during which patients are not arousable, even by painful stimulation.

scope__sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.item: Pediatric General Anesthesia / Deep Sedation Endorsement

scope__sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: "Mobile dental anesthesia provider" means a licensed and anesthesia-permitted dentist, physician or Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) that has a mobile dental unit and provides anesthesia in dental offices and facilities in the state;

scope__dental_hygienist_supervision_leve.quote: "Direct supervision" means the supervisory dentist is in the dental office or treatment facility and, during the appointment, personally examines the patient, diagnoses any conditions to be treated, and authorizes the procedures to be performed by a dental hygienist or dental assistant.

"Indirect supervision" means the supervisory dentist is in the dental office or treatment facility and has personally diagnosed any conditions to be treated, authorizes the procedures to be performed by a dental hygienist, remains in the dental office or treatment facility while the procedures are being performed

"General supervision" means the supervisory dentist has diagnosed any conditions to be treated within the past thirteen (13) months, has personally authorized the procedures to be performed by a dental hygienist

scope__advanced_practice_eligible_patien.quote: Another healthcare facility or long-term care facility as specifically approved by the Board of Dentistry.
A residential care home licensed under the Residential Care Act, Section 1-819 et seq. of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes;

Individuals with developmental or other disabilities (facility residents)
Nursery school or day care program enrollees
